{{Vanilla|Music Disc}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''music disc''' is an item that plays music in a [[jukebox]]. [[Matcha Flavoured]] makes almost every vanilla disc craftable from [[Disc Fragment|disc fragments]], and adds seven discs of its own: four by community musicians, one by the pack's background composer, and two vanilla tracks that have no disc in vanilla.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
Most discs are crafted from 8 [[Disc Fragment|disc fragments]] surrounding a center item. Custom discs are vanilla disc items with a different song and model, so the generated tables below show them under their base disc.

Any music disc can be crafted back into 3 disc fragments, and "Tears" into 1.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/disc_fragment_from_disc.json}}</ref>

All custom discs give a comparator output of 1.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/jukebox_song/crete.json}}</ref> Labyrinthine and Dry Hands use vanilla sound files; the others use sounds added by the resource pack. The Golden disc plays a demo version of the song.

== Usage ==
Discs are played in a [[jukebox]]. The [[Wandering Trader]] buys music discs for [[obol]]s.
{{Uses}}

|{{History line|0.5-alpha|The Wandering Trader buys music discs. Chicken jockeys drop the "Lava Chicken" disc.}}

{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Added three discs by DeBlezyBestie.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Elegy of the Abbey and Crete updated to new versions. Elegy of the Abbey can no longer be crafted.}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* "Golden" was composed by Ciren in memory of the developer's dog, Dakota.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/CREDITS.txt}}</ref>
* The folder <code>data/custom_music</code> holds only a note asking musicians to contribute music for more craftable discs.
